name: typewriter-effect
title: Typewriter Effect
blurb: Characters appear staggered in rapid sequence when section enters view, with a…
description: Takes an array of word objects and renders them as characters that fade in with staggered timing when the component enters the viewport. Includes a blinking blue cursor bar.
use_when: Hero sections or call-to-action copy that should feel animated and attention-grabbing on scroll.
avoid_when: Large amounts of text; animation is triggered on every view and can feel repetitive.
a11y: Text is rendered in the DOM and selectable; animation cannot be paused with prefers-reduced-motion.
